description: Agha Steel Industries Limited, incorporated in 2013, operates a steel melting and rolling complex at Port Qasim, Karachi, with annual melting capacity of 450,000 tonnes and rolling capacity of 250,000 tonnes. It produces billets and deformed reinforcing bars to ASTM and British standards, and describes its electric arc furnace as the only one in Pakistan's private sector.
headOffice: Plot No. NWIZ/1/P-133, SP-6, D-2, Port Qasim Authority, Karachi
